description: This line plot, titled "ChatGPT on Songs," illustrates the relationship between answer popularity and two metrics—accuracy and confidence—for a language model applied to songs. The x-axis, labeled "Answer Popularity," spans from 0 to 160 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The y-axis, labeled "Values," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three lines: a blue line with circular markers representing "Accuracy," a green line with triangle markers representing "Confidence," and a red line with square markers representing an unlabeled third metric. The blue "Accuracy" line starts at approximately 0.55, dips to its lowest point of 0.48 at an answer popularity of 20, then rises to a peak of 0.80 at an answer popularity of 80, and remains relatively stable around 0.82 for the remainder of the range. The green "Confidence" line remains consistently high, starting near 0.92, rising slightly to a peak of approximately 0.98 at an answer popularity of 100, and then gradually declining to about 0.96 at an answer popularity of 160. The red line begins at approximately 0.62, dips to 0.58 at 20, rises to a peak of 0.88 at 100, and then declines slightly to about 0.86 at 160.
